rules.title: Proposed ban on algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: A Massachusetts bill would ban using algorithms to set rents. It is not law yet; it was sent to the Senate Ways and Means committee.
rules.requirement_es: Un proyecto de ley de Massachusetts prohibiría usar algoritmos para fijar los alquileres. Todavía no es ley; fue enviado al comité de Medios y Arbitrios del Senado.
rules.coverage_text: Pending bill; the document does not give the bill text or its coverage.
rules.quote: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
